deviation: Before train point freeze, Terra parsed complete native vector JSON to summarize timing/RSS; root also parsed complete vectors for provenance, token/vector integrity and process review. Calibration and mixed vector values consequently entered memory before selected-point freeze. They were not scored or used for threshold selection in those reviews, but this does not satisfy a literal prohibition on reading later vectors.
selectionImplementation: The frozen selector itself opens train-only vectors and train-only labels. Separate selected-point files preceded later quality calculation. These facts do not erase the earlier complete-vector reads.
permittedClaim: Report reproducible retrospective development numbers with the deviation. Do not call the batch strictly isolated, independent, blind, release-qualified or production-ready.
firstGenerationOnly: The measured EmbeddingGemma candidate is onnx-community/embeddinggemma-300m-ONNX, not google/embeddinggemma-2. No second-generation timings, RAM or quality were measured in this batch.
nextIndependentEvidence: After final method freeze, author a new full-language independent holdout, keep raw later vectors inaccessible to resource/provenance reporters until one-shot quality is recorded, and separately report resource metadata.
